criteria.criterion: Intake start ledger targets use ticket identity plus repository, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k intake_start_dedup_key_uses_ticket_identity_and_repo`

Ticket write-back content changes after a terminal execution replay the completed intake record, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k ticket_writeback_change_after_terminal_execution_is_deduplicated`

Operator-requested intake retry can admit the ticket after the ledger record is cleared, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k cleared_intake_dedup_allows_operator_requested_rerun`

Prior digest-based intake ledger rows replay under the stable key during deployment, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_digest_based_intake_start_replays_for_the_same_ticket_repo`

Legacy pending intake rows create a current-key row before effects run, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_pending_intake_start_is_completed_under_the_current_key`
Legacy completed intake rows replay with the legacy key, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_completed_intake_start_replays_with_the_legacy_key`
Legacy completed intake rows for other repositories do not replay, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_completed_intake_start_for_a_different_repo_does_not_replay`
Legacy repo suffix matching treats underscores literally, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_intake_repo_match_treats_underscores_literally`

The rebar watermark poll still surfaces a never-run ticket when its status becomes admissible, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_rebar_intake_watermark.py -k ticket_that_becomes_admissible_later_is_still_seen`

A pending legacy intake record makes the in-memory ledger report the current key as reentrant, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k pending_legacy_intake_start_makes_the_current_key_reentrant`

A pending legacy intake record scoped to another repository leaves the in-memory ledger non-reentrant, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k pending_intake_start_for_a_different_repo_is_not_reentrant`

A pending legacy intake row makes the Postgres ledger report the current key as reentrant, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k pending_legacy_intake_start_row_makes_the_current_key_reentrant`

A pending legacy intake row scoped to another repository leaves the Postgres ledger non-reentrant, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k pending_legacy_intake_start_row_for_another_repo_is_not_reentrant`
The most recently updated legacy intake row decides the replay, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k the_most_recently_updated_legacy_intake_start_row_wins`
Bug 'Key intake deduplication on ticket identity rather than mutable content' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
